product.name: LocalCloud
product.productionBoundary: LocalCloud emulates bounded local development workflows. Validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.
product.licenseSummary: The proprietary license permits limited non-commercial personal use by an Individual Developer acting personally; the license text governs.

services.name: Bigtable
supported: instances/tables/families (release-unverified) — Extended features differ between the mutable v0.0.1 dependency, cached artifact, and current dependency checkout; qualify the assembled image before relying on them. [prod_only] Single-node emulator by design; clusters, multi-region, replication require Google infrastructure. GoogleSQL queries (ExecuteQuery/PrepareQuery) are unsupported; use the Bigtable Data API filter pipeline. Cluster and app-profile APIs are metadata CRUD only; topology and routing are not enforced. Session protocol (OpenTable/OpenAuthorizedView/OpenMaterializedView) is unsupported.

Core row reads, mutations, filters, and sampling (release-unverified) — The inspected cached artifact implements core data workflows with simplified local semantics and no production quotas, concurrency, or distribution guarantees; the assembled image is not qualified.

Table and column-family administration (release-unverified) — Table and family lifecycle is observed in source artifacts; undelete, snapshots, production consistency, and assembled-image qualification are not provided.
Instance administration (release-unverified) — Instance lifecycle is local metadata behavior without billing, quota, replication, or multi-region semantics.

PostgreSQL-backed LocalCloud persistence (release-unverified) — Persistence is configured under the mounted LocalCloud volume, but dependency identity, restart recovery, and the assembled image have not been qualified.

Cached-artifact extended administration methods (release-unverified) — Extended methods differ between the cached module, mutable v0.0.1 input, local tag, and dependency HEAD; use the feature-specific entries below and qualify an immutable assembled image.
Forward-compatible unsupported RPC handling (release-unverified) — Unimplemented RPC handling is a compatibility boundary, not evidence that new Bigtable methods are supported.
Single-partition change streams (release-unverified) — Observed in the machine-local cached artifact; no assembled-image qualification.
Cluster and app-profile metadata CRUD (release-unverified) — Metadata only; no topology or routing fidelity.
Backup metadata and schema-only restore (release-unverified) — Rows are not preserved by restore.
Permissive IAM API stub (release-unverified) — Does not enforce production access control.
Logical-view metadata CRUD (release-unverified) — Queries are not executed.
Local materialized views (release-unverified) — No backfill; parser and schema behavior are limited.
gaps: Extended features differ between the mutable v0.0.1 dependency, cached artifact, and current dependency checkout; qualify the assembled image before relying on them.
[prod_only] Single-node emulator by design; clusters, multi-region, replication require Google infrastructure.
GoogleSQL queries (ExecuteQuery/PrepareQuery) are unsupported; use the Bigtable Data API filter pipeline.
Cached-artifact extended features are bounded local implementations, not production topology, routing, backup, IAM, or query parity.
Session protocol (OpenTable/OpenAuthorizedView/OpenMaterializedView) is unsupported.
services.caveat: Release-unverified: qualify the dependency identity and assembled LocalCloud image before relying on positive workflows.

services.name: Spanner
supported: instances/databases (release-unverified) — LocalCloud exposes gRPC on 24085 and REST on 24086; it does not package PGAdapter or PostgreSQL wire access. Core admin behavior is dependency-backed but the assembled LocalCloud image is not qualified. Cloud Spanner Backup APIs are unsupported; internal safety snapshots are not Backup API support.

DDL, GoogleSQL/PostgreSQL-dialect SQL, DML, and transactions through the Spanner API (release-unverified) — LocalCloud packages no PGAdapter or PostgreSQL-wire endpoint; MERGE is unsupported and the assembled image is not qualified.
GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL-dialect change streams (release-unverified) — Bounded dependency implementation pending assembled-image qualification.
TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI and RESERVOIR (release-unverified) — SYSTEM and REPEATABLE remain unsupported; assembled image not qualified.
Permissive IAM gateway stubs (partial) — setIamPolicy/getIamPolicy/testIamPermissions do not enforce production IAM.
gaps: LocalCloud exposes gRPC on 24085 and REST on 24086; it does not package PGAdapter or PostgreSQL wire access.
Core Spanner API behavior is dependency-backed but not qualified in an identified assembled LocalCloud image; production IAM, Backup APIs, scale, quotas, and operations remain out of scope.
PostgreSQL dialect is available through the Spanner API, not through PostgreSQL wire protocol.
MERGE: unsupported — The integrated dependency does not implement Spanner MERGE.
Cloud Spanner Backup APIs: unsupported — Internal safety snapshots do not implement Cloud Spanner backup or restore APIs.
services.caveat: Release-unverified: qualify the dependency identity and assembled LocalCloud image before relying on positive workflows.

services.name: BigQuery
supported: datasets.create/list/delete (release-unverified) — Dataset lifecycle is source- and client-profile specific; no assembled-image qualification supports a coverage percentage or production IAM parity.
tables.create/list/delete (release-unverified) — BigQuery operation remains release-unverified; review the service-level limitations and evidence before relying on production parity.

Common SELECT, JOIN, CTE, window, PIVOT/UNPIVOT, and DML workflows (release-unverified) — DuckDB coercion, division, geography, and error behavior can differ from BigQuery; feature edges and assembled-image behavior remain unqualified.

DECLARE, SET, IF/WHILE/LOOP, BEGIN/EXCEPTION, CALL, EXECUTE IMMEDIATE (release-unverified) — This is a partial local interpreter; complete authorization, system variables, parameter modes, sessions, and assembled-image qualification are not established.

Materialized-view physical-table emulation with explicit refresh (release-unverified) — Does not establish automatic or incremental refresh, optimizer integration, staleness policy, or distributed maintenance parity.

Source-specific external CSV, JSON, Parquet, and configured local GCS paths (release-unverified) — BigLake, object tables, cross-cloud authentication, all formats, production sharding, and schema-evolution parity are not established.

Selected Storage Read/Write API profiles with AVRO and Arrow (release-unverified) — Read/write behavior is stream-, feature-, and client-profile specific; universal SDK or connector compatibility is not established.
INFORMATION_SCHEMA views (release-unverified) — The dependency mixes populated views, empty compatibility stubs, unknown views, and unsupported control-plane views; no fixed view count is valid.
ROLLUP, CUBE, and GROUPING SETS (release-unverified) — Upstream execution tests exist, but semantic edge cases and behavior in an identified assembled LocalCloud image are not qualified.
TABLESAMPLE (release-unverified) — Upstream execution exists, but semantic parity is weakly evidenced and behavior in an identified assembled LocalCloud image is not qualified.
gaps: Feature behavior varies by source revision and client profile; no assembled-image qualification currently supports a coverage percentage, test total, or function count.
DuckDB type coercion and division behavior can differ from production BigQuery.
Grouping extensions and TABLESAMPLE have upstream execution evidence but no qualified assembled-image evidence.
Scripting is a partial local interpreter; materialized views use physical-table emulation and explicit refresh semantics.
External tables and Storage APIs are source-, format-, and client-profile specific.
INFORMATION_SCHEMA mixes populated views, schema-compatible empty stubs, unknown views, and unsupported views.
BIGNUMERIC, AEAD/NET, search/vector, and geography behavior require feature-specific caveats; do not infer full production parity.
BQML, distributed execution, reservations, billing, production IAM, quotas, and audit behavior remain unsupported.
services.caveat: Release-unverified: qualify the dependency identity and assembled LocalCloud image before relying on positive workflows.
